semantics.timing: outputs respond combinationally to current inputs; no cycle latency or sampling edge
semantics.reset: no reset port or reset behavior
semantics.initialization: no stored state or initialization needed
semantics.dont_care_policy: never-occurring inputs may take either Boolean output; outputs need not agree there

numeric.bit_order: a is MSB, d is LSB
numeric.operations: Boolean AND, OR, NOT only; no arithmetic datapath

verification.oracle: independent case lookup from original ones/zeros lists, not implementation expressions
verification.simulation: exhaustively drive all 16 binary input combinations, check both outputs on 12 specified combinations; do not constrain four dont-care combinations; repeat reverse order to check combinational response
verification.form_minimality: enumerate admissible implicants covering ones (SOP) and zeros (POS), with dont-cares allowed, then find minimum term count and literal count
verification.tool: specified Icarus v12 and matching vvp, -g2012, explicit dev_tb top, finite shell timeouts
verification.scope: development simulation only, no official evaluation, synthesis or board access
